_about: Settings for bot.py. See README.md for what each market asks and why these defaults. Days are counted from the set's 17Lands start date (e.g. FRA: 2026-09-29 15:00 UTC).

seventeen_lands.user_agent: mtg-manifold-bot/0.1 (+https://toskicologist.github.io/MTG-draft-sets-infographics/; Toskicologist@protonmail.com; a few requests per day)

checkpoints.label: on {date}
checkpoints.note: November 9, 2026 is the day Reality Fracture Premier Draft ends on MTG Arena.

_checkpoint_keys: kinds = markets in priority order; sequential = each opens only once all before it are open (so the pair market, M$250, waits for the three M$100 card markets); open_until = no new markets from this checkpoint after this UTC time.
